text: Given a mocked GET /api/Monitoring response with records across 2 companies and 3 computers, When msp360_get_monitoring() is called with no filter, Then the result contains one entry per record with company, computer, plan, status, and error fields populated.
Given the same mocked monitoring data, When msp360_get_monitoring(user_id="U1") is called, Then only records for U1 are returned.

Given a mocked response with 300 monitoring records, When msp360_get_monitoring() is called with the default limit, Then the result has at most 200 records, has_more=true, and the serialized size is under 20000 characters.
Given a mocked GET /api/Computers/{hid}/Plans response with 2 plans, When msp360_list_plans(hid="H1") is called, Then both plans' id/name/type are returned.
Given a mocked plan-info response showing Status: "Error", When msp360_get_plan_info(hid="H1", plan_id="P1") is called, Then the result's status and error_message reflect that.

Given a mocked history response with 3 runs, When msp360_get_plan_history(hid="H1", plan_id="P1", year=2026, month=10) is called, Then exactly those 3 runs are returned with start time/duration/status/data volume.
Given a mocked POST .../start that returns 200, When msp360_start_plan(hid="H1", plan_id="P1") is called, Then the result reports status: "started".
Given a mocked POST .../stop that returns 200, When msp360_stop_plan(hid="H1", plan_id="P1") is called, Then the result reports status: "stopped".
Given a mocked 404 from the vendor for an unknown plan_id, When any of msp360_get_plan_info/start_plan/stop_plan is called, Then the tool returns a not_found error envelope, not a raw exception.
Given a mocked 401 from POST /api/Provider/Login (bad credentials), When any tool is called, Then the tool returns an unauthorized error envelope with retryable=false and does not retry indefinitely.

Given a cached valid token that the vendor then rejects (401) on a subsequent call, When the tool call is made, Then the client re-logs-in exactly once and retries; if the retry also 401s, the tool returns the unauthorized envelope.

Given two concurrent requests carrying different X-Msp360-Username/X-Msp360-Password pairs hit the running container at the same time, When both resolve, Then each response reflects only its own credential pair's token/data, with no cross-talk in the cached token map.
steps: Start the service locally (docker-compose up or uvicorn directly).
Configure two mock MSP360 backends (or two real test accounts, if available) returning distinguishable company/computer names.
Fire msp360_get_monitoring concurrently with X-Msp360-Username/X-Msp360-Password for account A and account B against the same running container.
Inspect both responses and the in-process token cache (via a debug log line or test hook).
expect: Account A's response contains only account A's company/computer names; account B's only account B's; the token cache has two distinct entries keyed by each credential pair, never one overwriting the other.
evidence: No real second MSP360 account was available, so executed via the local-harness substitute the design doc itself proposed: tests/test_tools.py::test_concurrent_requests_with_different_credentials_never_cross_talk drives two concurrent asyncio Tasks against two mocked vendor backends behind the shared base URL (each Task gets its own contextvars copy, the same isolation CredentialMiddleware relies on per ASGI request). Result A's company_name == CompanyA, result B's == CompanyB, and the token cache holds two distinct entries (tokA, tokB) keyed by each credential's fingerprint. `uv run pytest -q` -> 19 passed, 2026-11-03.

text: Given a real MSP360 test account with a plan safe to interrupt, When msp360_start_plan then msp360_stop_plan are called against it, Then MSP360's own UI/history shows a run that started and was then cancelled, confirming the OQ1 REST paths are correct.
steps: Obtain a real MSP360 Managed Backup test account with at least one computer and one backup plan safe to start/stop.
Call msp360_list_plans(hid) to find a plan id.
Within a few seconds, call msp360_stop_plan(hid, plan_id).
Open the MSP360 web console (or call msp360_get_plan_history) for that plan.
expect: The plan's run history shows one run that started at the time of the start call and ended early (cancelled/stopped) rather than completing normally.
evidence: No MSP360 test account identified as of this design pass (2026-11-02). Per references/mcp-track.md 2.5/3, missing a vendor test account does not block design or merge; this case is recorded as needing one rather than marked pass.
